label: Nexo nas Escolas
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: preview-only conceptual photograph for a Brazilian institutional website. Generate exactly ONE standalone photograph, landscape 1536 x 1024, ratio 3:2. Highest photographic quality, refined but convincing natural Brazilian editorial photography. Consistent subtle navy blue and turquoise accents wherever plausible, neutral-to-warm sunlight, moderate contrast, crisp honest textures with no HDR. Keep all key subjects safely inside a centered crop to 1.6:1. The photo depicts a conceptual scene, not documentation of actual Nexo activities.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermarks, no dark overlay, no typography. No neon, no 3D rendering, no collage, no artificial stock-photo poses.
Primary request: a participatory conversation circle in a contemporary, welcoming and entirely plausible Brazilian classroom.
Scene and subjects: 7 people total: six young students aged 16–20 seated at light wooden classroom tables arranged to encourage dialogue, and one young adult female university-student facilitator standing, guiding the discussion. Natural diverse Brazilian appearances, entirely fictional people. One seated student raises a hand; the others listen and interact spontaneously. A modest number of realistic notebooks and pencils, well-maintained classroom without artificial luxury; simple blank blackboard with no readable writing.
Composition and light: wide candid photo from the back/side of the room, faces small enough to remain natural, the exchange of ideas is the protagonist. Soft side-window sunlight. Clear, elegant photographic composition with comfortable space around the group, authentic contemporary Brazilian furnishings and casual unbranded clothing.
Avoid: American stock-photo classroom clichés, flags, branded uniforms, known faces, everyone looking at camera, exaggerated smiles, excessive props.
